name: plate-map
title: Plate Map
description: A 6 to 1536-well microplate as an ARIA grid, as bare wells or the whole plate to scale (SBS footprint, true pitch, molded labels, a chamfered corner where notch puts it, drawn as a solid fill or an outline, with its front side and a scannable Code 128 barcode label underneath): wells by group or by value on a sequential or diverging scale, excluded wells, a hover card with lit headers, a legend, and rectangle, additive and line selection traced as one filleted outline; wellRange, parseWell, wellName, cellsOutline and code128 helpers.
